config.order: alternating forward/reverse; fresh process per backend/trial

limitations: Completed frame includes CPU encoding, queueing and GPU execution; it is not GPU timestamp time
CPU-before-wait subtracts an explicitly timed completion fence from a serial frame; not asynchronous throughput
Fixed font files, Light hinting and grayscale AA requested; backend rasterization quality can differ
Not full application startup, layout, scrolling or catalog navigation performance
text_quality_reference: Core Text native appearance; no Skia-identical rasterization gate

library_tests.features: quartz only, verifies offscreen feature isolation

load_snapshot_export: Application names are normalized in this committed summary; local raw artifacts retain sampled process basenames.
published_path_policy: Checkout-relative paths and ~/ home placeholders; recorded measurements and artifact/source hashes are unchanged.
privacy_history_policy: Personal paths, background process names and local device identifiers are omitted. Source commit IDs from the superseded branch are redacted; content hashes and measurements are historical and predate the upstream rebase.
